sourceBoundary: The decoded fall and hit_ground records belong to a leg-stun reaction under the aggro hit branch. Native charge wall triggers and an original weakness timer are unverified. The subsequent FIG hold at 5442968 references behemoth_com_prone_slam_360; the separately sourced prone-to-biped clip is an adaptation for the wall reaction.

phases.purpose: get up without replaying the biped leg-stun windup or prone counterattack

minecraftAdaptation.legacy40TickExposure: Keep the absolute start and end. Keep both fall slices and shorten the hold and exit to fit the legacy duration.
minecraftAdaptation.otherExposure: Keep the 70- and 140-tick combat windows. Play the early biped stumble/brace at normal source cadence and blend to live idle during the final 12 ticks. The late counterattack arc belongs to a different action.
minecraftAdaptation.collision: Render and receiving hit Regions both call GoliathMotion.pose. Defense UI and attack eligibility use EXPOSED_START/EXPOSED game time. No recovery root displacement, committed charge Hit, or prone attack is emitted.
minecraftAdaptation.wallAudio: Vanilla Minecraft stone impact at charge cancellation.

transitionBlends.entry: 6 ticks from the sampled outgoing charge phase to the fall
transitionBlends.exit: 6 ticks from the end of the rise clip to the live idle pose
transitionBlends.sampler: SourceBossMotion.blend plus reciprocal parent scale compensation, shared by rendering and hurt regions
transitionBlends.persistence: Packed impact phase and source phase age are synchronized and saved with the active exposure.
transitionBlends.rise: 8 ticks from the biped leg-stun ground-contact pose into the prone-to-biped clip

headContinuity.neckMesh: Three overlapping authored sections bind to source_Spine_3, source_Neck and source_Neck_2. Their endpoints use the exported local joint offsets. The client and receiving collision read the same geometry resource.
headContinuity.spike: The active Minecraft ground spike retains its hit tick and uses the referenced preparation/release/recovery slices of behemoth_com_crawl_front_spike with a Minecraft blend between source frames 24 and 90.
headContinuity.gait: The walking phase and blend are driven by real horizontal travel. The vanilla hit-reaction write to WalkAnimationState speed does not select gait.
headContinuity.verification: Head joint sampled at 1/8 game-tick intervals. 70-tick exposure maximum 12.67 to 8.97, 140-tick exposure 12.68 to 9.08, active spike 11.22 to 7.47, all in rig blocks before the uniform 1.375 presentation scale.
